operators.name: op_unfold
semantics: Performs the same operation as torch.nn.functional.unfold with stride=1, padding=0.
Input x has shape [N, C, H, W], float32, contiguous, on CUDA.
kernel_size = (kernel_h, kernel_w), dilation = (dilation_h, dilation_w).
Output L = ((H - dilation_h*(kernel_h-1) - 1) // 1 + 1) * ((W - dilation_w*(kernel_w-1) - 1) // 1 + 1).
Output ordering matches F.unfold: channel-major, each block corresponds to a spatial patch.
Must support arbitrary strides in input? Contract says contiguous, but we state layout: contiguous. The kernel can assume contiguous.
Implementation must use cuDNN or custom kernel; no torch ops in C++.

operators.name: op_batch_norm_1d_training
semantics: Computes BatchNorm1d in training mode: y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight + bias.
Input is shape [N, C, L] (after unfold). The normalization is performed over N and L dimensions for each channel C.
Mean and variance are computed using batch statistics (not running).

Running mean and variance are updated in-place using momentum: running_mean = (1 - momentum) * running_mean + momentum * batch_mean; running_var uses unbiased variance with factor N*L/(N*L-1) if N*L > 1.
If weight is None, it is treated as ones; if bias is None, it is treated as zeros.
All tensors are on CUDA and contiguous.
Must be implemented with custom CUDA kernels or cuBLAS; no torch ops.
Input x shape [16,3,512,512], float32, CUDA.
kernel_size=(3,3), dilation=(2,2), stride=1, padding=0.
Output shape [16, 27, 258064].
Unfold extracts sliding local blocks of size (dilation_h*(kernel_h-1)+1) x (dilation_w*(kernel_w-1)+1) = 5x5 from each input channel, vectorized to length 27, arranged in L = 258064 columns.
BatchNorm1d with num_features=27, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True.
In training mode, uses batch mean and variance across N and L dimensions.
Updates running_mean and running_var in-place.
Output shape [16, 27, 258064], float32.
Returns the batch-normalized tensor.
